summary: Use covering checkpoint metadata reads for affected operation repair

replay.detail: No replay or caller changes. Current-main OperationMetadata fold already streams checkpoint candidates without a retained vector; preserve that fold and all selected typed decoding, while the affected checkpoint lookup uses a partial covering index. No first/last LIMIT or old stored-vector reducer is adopted.

schema.detail: Adds checkpoint_claims_operation_digest, a partial covering index on operation_id, request_digest and id, at ordinary Store open. Current schema version18 and checkpoint data are unchanged. First-open index construction over existing metadata remains a cost requiring measurement; older builds ignore the additive index.

rules.detail: Current-main stored canonical/fallback, conflict decision, repaired exclusions and live/checkpoint membership remain unchanged. Selected malformed metadata still refuses. No rules/digest change.

compatibility.detail: No wire or API signature change. Existing old/new dependency collection, repair savepoints, outer transaction, failure rollback, runtime authority and commit-before-ACK remain in place.

downtime.detail: First-open additive index construction remains disclosed. Complete affected-operation checkpoint history is still scanned/decoded; no bound on full repair lists or whole heal. Actual current-main and integrated hetz2 perf figures are recorded separately when available; no historical pass transfer or production claim.

manual.detail: No live heal, replay, reset, policy action or manual database operation is requested. Unrelated damaged operation rows are not silently rebuilt by a record repair.

recovery.detail: Older builds ignore the extra additive index and continue their original checkpoint enumeration. No immutable record/data rewrite or format migration.
